verdict.rationale: Datadog ships first-party AI features inside the product: Watchdog for automated anomaly/root-cause detection and Bits AI as an in-product AI assistant that surfaces insights and suggestions from telemetry data. These are documented as native product capabilities rather than external add-ons. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and no community corroboration of Bits AI/Watchdog usefulness in the evidence pack.
